profile.headline: Dad 1st!💯| Full Stack Dev & Coding Freelancer | Chronic Illness Survivor & Mental Health Advocate | Former Manager With A Decade+ Experience In Leadership Roles Across Financial Services, Hospitality & Data Analytics
profile.summary: Natural born leader with over a decade of management & coaching experience across multiple industries. From hospitality, financial services and data analytics, to student mentoring and tutoring at all levels. Empathetic, adaptable and ready for new challenges!

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Programming · Communication · Problem Solving · Time Management

positions.title: PRP Coordinator & Transition Home Manager
positions.description:
PRP (Psychiatric Rehabilitation Program) Coordinator - Assisting youths and adults with qualifying mental health, addiction and substance abuse challenges. Offering community-based and in-home services to help enhance necessary skills for rewarding and healthy daily living! (*The youths don't need a specific diagnosis to qualify, they can benefit from a general, "big-brother" style mentorship program which includes tutoring, sports training, fitness / nutrition and overall life coaching.)

Responsible for the training and onboarding of new PRP hires to ensure note uniformity and that the ins and outs of Icanotes, Zoobook and all other software platforms necessary for client records are being used effectively.

Transition Home Manager - Manages home of up to 8 adults who are following unique programs to help fight their personal addictions as they transition to independence and health again. Collects random drug tests to ensure all tenants are following their programs and the general house rules. Ensures all curfews are met, chores are completed and that all tenants are respecting each other and their respective personal belongings. Holds weekly meetings to check on progress, receive feedback on matters in the home and provide general necessary updates to the tenants at home, including them throughout the recovery process and emphasizing the importance of clear communication and teamwork.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Teamwork · Addiction Counseling · Communication · Case Management · Mental Health Counseling · Empathy

positions.title: Customer Service Lead & Loan Opener
positions.description:
Customer Service Lead (July 2020 - April 2021)
-Trained new employees that were hired to a similar role on our direct team, to ensure uniform applications and thoroughness. Training areas included encompass software data entry, income calculation, loan program guidelines and more.

Loan Opener (March 2020 - July 2020)
-Analyzed clients’ “home purchasing power” by completing full applications to review their credit reports, assets, liabilities, and income. Developed plans to help rebuild credit / finances so any currently unqualified clients could eventually achieve their financial goals.

NMLS ID: 1379806  

-Analyzed clients’ “home purchasing power” by completing full reviews of their credit reports, assets, liabilities, and income. Developed plans to help rebuild credit / finances so any currently unqualified clients could eventually achieve their financial goals.

positions.title: Licensed Mortgage Loan Originator
positions.locationName: 901 North Pitt St. Suite 320 Alexandria, Virginia 22314
positions.description:
Providing loan solutions to the nine million Americans who were adversely effected by the housing market crash.  At America Funding Loans we cater specific loan programs to those who can't qualify with conventional banks. Financing options the day after a foreclosure, short sale or Bankruptcy. In addition, we offer special financing to business owners who can not prove their income via tax returns. We also have options for those foreign nationals without reporting credit. It is our job to help the people who have given up on the American dream of home-ownership. It is our job at America Funding Loans to help Americans access the equity in their homes when they need it, not when their credit score deems it acceptable.

-One of the co-founding loan consultants invited to help build this start-up mortgage company.
-Handled a large portfolio of loan products as a broker, including Non-QM products, VA, FHA, USDA, etc.
-Responsible for managing the sales floor, and generating daily reports to track efficiency & marketing strategies.
-Adept with various lead management/loan software platforms including lending space, Velocify and encompass.
-Instrumental in integrating the Five9 internet telephony system with Velocify and encompass to ensure the software was communicating with each other and maximizing loan officer efficiency, even when working from home.
positions.insights: Skills: Financial Analysis · Data Entry · Account Management · Communication

positions.description:
-Accountable for updating the cafe’s profit and loss statement daily, while making business trend based adjustments to meet budget for labor, food costs, etc.
-Responsible for hiring and training new staff, designing weekly schedules and performed human resource duties in conjunction with corporate Nordstrom.
-Worked alongside the executive chef to complete ordering, maintain food quality & ensure that all kitchen systems (aloha product mix, employee safety procedures, etc.) were being used effectively.
-Designed weekly schedules and performed human resource duties in conjunction with corporate Nordstrom.
-Arranged special catering events, networked with local businesses and used social media to help market products.

positions.title: Account Executive
positions.description:
NMLS ID: 1379806

I had the privilege of speaking with veterans on a daily basis to advise them on their finances and get them qualified for a home loan. It was a true honor to be able to serve them for a change and put veterans and their families in homes. 

Licensed in the following states: MD, VA, KS, IL, CA, CO, NV, ID, KY, FL, SC, NC & TX

Mortgage Loan Originator, (May 2015-January 2016)
-Completed the SAFE exam and received my Mortgage Originator License and state specific licenses
-Reviewed borrowers’ credit reports to put together plans to re-establish credit and improve financial well-being.
-Proficient in analyzing business and personal tax returns and all the schedules that accompany them, as well as every form of W2 or fixed income. By calculating their disposable income, I have been able to determine the borrowers’ true “ability to repay” and mitigate risk more efficiently.

Campus Representative/Recruiting Intern, (January 2015-May 2015)
-Enhanced the company’s brand and recruited qualified candidates, contributing to its rapid growth. 
-Orchestrated and implemented a business networking event for college seniors to get introduced to the company.
positions.insights: Skills: Financial Analysis · Data Entry · Account Management · Communication

positions.title: Restaurant Manager, Bartender and Server - Cunningham's
positions.description:
Restaurant Manager (March 2014-May 2015)
-Managed and supported a team of about 40-50 employees in the front and back of the house.
-Responsible for financial control and management of cash deposits pre and post shift.
-Accountable for liquor and wine deliveries as well as additional inventory.

Server/Bartender (October 2013-March 2014)
-Bartended a craft cocktail menu with all house-made syrups, fresh squeezed juice and self-infused spirits.
-Catered private events such as weddings, business meetings, baby showers etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Financial Analysis · Hospitality · Communication · Data Analysis
